1.Name: Thane
1.Story: The Rayne family's housekeeper, the silent swordsman. After his best friend, Baden Rayne died in battle, he has been serving the Rayne household as a way of repaying his debt. He hopes to return the Formal Apparel to the Raynes.
1.Keyword: He was patrolling near to where the Formal Apparel was kept.

2.Name: Leofric
2.Story: An honorable Earl that resides in a manor nearby Oakenfell. He loves to read, and has a keen interest in historical items. He received an invitation to Prince Lester's dance.
2.Keyword: He received an invitation but did not attend the dance.

3.Name: Kren
3.Story: A wanted criminal Durri that roams the Land of the Exiles. He was responsible for many robberies, and will go to any length to fulfill his goals. His family are adept at tunnel digging.
3.Keyword: A tunnel with the hallmarks of a Durri was discovered at the dance.
